description: Source code for NettyStreamManager class implementing StreamManager for serving files in Apache Spark RPC over Netty, including methods for adding/removing files, jars, directories, and opening streams.

classes.name: NettyStreamManager
classes.description: Implementation of StreamManager for serving files and directories over RPC in Spark using Netty.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a file from the manager by key.

methods.name: removeJar
methods.description: Removes a jar file from the manager by key.

methods.name: getChunk
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException; chunk retrieval not supported.

methods.name: openStream
methods.description: Opens a stream for a given streamId, returning a ManagedBuffer if the file exists.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Registers a file and returns its URL.

methods.name: addJar
methods.description: Registers a jar file and returns its URL.

methods.name: addDirectory
methods.description: Registers a directory with a base URI.

methods.name: addDirectoryIfAbsent
methods.description: Registers a directory if not already registered.
